title: Notify the EPA of contaminated land
what: As owner or occupier of land that is or is likely to be a contaminated site, stop activities that worsen it and notify the Director of the pollutant and the circumstances.

laws.title: Environmental Management and Pollution Control Act 1994 (Tas)

sources.title: Environmental Management and Pollution Control Act 1994 (Tas)
sources.quote: If the owner or occupier of any area of land knows, reasonably believes or should in the circumstances reasonably believe that the area of land is or is likely to be a contaminated site, the owner or occupier – (a) must not commence or continue any activity
